verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is one community user's hands-on report that a new model on Hugging Face can be pulled with a single 'ollama pull'. This points to the product itself pulling HF models, but no first-party documentation in the pack describes Hugging Face integration. Missing for 10: first-party docs on pulling or running models directly from Hugging Face, the supported formats (e.g. GGUF) and repo syntax, and independent corroboration beyond a single comment.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can download and run open models directly from Hugging Face

citations.quote: A new model on HF or Ollama registry? One 'ollama pull' and it's available.
